tasks.description: Temporary GPT-5.5 solo bounded operational repair after S-TC2H7. S-TC2H7/v0h applied the correct high-level LetMPCEnv.step([H]) action but still stopped before any solver or plant resource with TypeError("'float' object is not subscriptable"). The v0h raw trace localizes the exception before mpc.solve: all arms had solver_calls_observed=0, plant_steps_observed=0, history_initialization_meta.initial_observation.observation_exception shows the same TypeError, and env.step saw no internal solver events. Source inspection shows LetMPCEnv/ControlSystem/TVP expect env.control_system.tvps[name].values in the legacy list-of-dicts format with true/forecast keys, whereas prior wrappers scalarized those values for controller initial-guess metadata and wrote the scalarized arrays back into the environment TVP storage. This task performs only the corresponding interface-format repair: keep the S-TC2H7 high-level mpc_horizon env.step path but restore raw list-of-dicts TVP values for env.get_observation/env.step while using scalarized TVP only for strict MPC initial-guess metadata. Preserve source242_slot0_branch_start, goal case.tvp.trajectory_endpoint[61], H=[12,15,35], V15_shared terminal, canonical initialization, no training/refit, no validation64, no sealed/final-test access, and solver/plant caps. Pre-resource backup/prior gates must pass; if backup proof is absent or stale, fail zero-resource and preserve the gate evidence. Strict pass requires all three H arms to advance at least one plant step with no env/controller exceptions and full per-step cost/safety/solver/timing traces.
